The product is a natural stone (Piracema White) simply cut or sawn with a flat or even (polished) surface, fitting the wording of heading 6802: 'Worked monumental or building stone... simply cut or sawn, with a flat or even surface.'
The product functions as a rubber vulcanizing agent (prepared rubber accelerator) containing an aromatic rubber accelerator, specifically classified under 3812.10.10.00.
The product is an insulated electric conductor fitted with connectors for a voltage not exceeding 1,000 V, specifically described under heading 8544.42 as 'Fitted with connectors.'

The cables are insulated electric conductors fitted with connectors, not coaxial (8544.20) or parts of headphones (8518.90), and fall under 'Other electric conductors, for a voltage not exceeding 1,000 V' per heading 8544.49.
The costume ensemble, including the Tarot cards, is classified under 9505.90.60.00 as a festive or entertainment article per the heading terms and prior rulings (e.g., N329862).
The blouse is not knitted or crocheted (loose-weave textile fabric), so Chapter 62 applies, specifically heading 6206 for women's blouses of other textile materials.
The polished steel balls are finished components specifically intended for use in ball bearings (heading 8482), and the HTSUS provides a subheading for 'Other' ball bearings under 8482.10.50.68.
The products are preparations of a kind used in animal feeding for nutritional and physiological support, specifically described under HTS heading 2309.

The product is a cosmetic skincare patch with LEDs for non-medical purposes, fitting the Chapter 33 heading 'perfumery, cosmetic or toilet preparations, not elsewhere specified or included' (3307.90.00.00).
The product is a foldable handheld fan primarily made of cotton woven fabric, classifying it under 6307.90.98.91 as 'Other made up textile articles' per the Chapter 63 Note 7 and heading terms.

The product is Roflumilast in bulk powder form, not put up in measured doses or retail packaging, fitting the description of 'Heterocyclic compounds with nitrogen hetero-atom(s) only' under heading 2933.39.41.00.
The product is a radiobroadcast receiver for motor vehicles, combined in the same housing with sound recording or reproducing apparatus (USB/Bluetooth playback), classifying under 8527.21.40.80.
The product is a non-functional Halloween decoration, specifically classifiable under 9505.90.60.00 as 'festive articles' per the heading and Chapter 95 Note 1(e).

Clodronic Acid Disodium Salt Tetrahydrate is an acyclic amide derivative (bisphosphonate) with a carboxyamide-function, specifically classified under 2924.19.80.00 as 'Other' acyclic amides and their salts.

The costume is classified under 9505.90.60.00 as a festive or entertainment article for adults, per the heading's wording 'festive, carnival or other entertainment articles' and consistent with similar rulings (e.g., N337371).
The product is crushed natural basalt stone, unworked and not a precious or semiprecious stone, fitting the description of 'other articles' under heading 6810, specifically 6810.99.00.80.

Etripamil is a chemically defined pharmaceutical agent in bulk powder form, classifiable under 2934.99.30.00 as a 'drug' per the chapter note and heading terms for heterocyclic compounds with nitrogen.
The ear cup assemblies are parts of a headset, not complete headphones or earphones, fitting the wording 'parts thereof' under heading 8518.90.
The screw is of stainless steel, fitting the description 'Of stainless steel' in subheading 7318.15.60.70.
The product is an insulated data cable with a voltage rating of 250V, not fitted with connectors, falling under the residual 'Other' provision of 8544.49.90.00.
The product is a sweet baked good primarily made from wheat flour and classified under HTS 1905.90.10.50 as 'Pastries, cakes and similar sweet baked products; puddings.'
The product is a mineral or chemical fertilizer containing the three fertilizing elements nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, as specified in HTS heading 3105.20.00.00.
The product is a decorative garden arbor of tubular steel, classifiable under the wording 'statuettes and other ornaments, of base metal' in heading 8306.

The product is a medicament for therapeutic use, put up in measured doses for retail sale, and specifically a dermatological agent for topical application containing diclofenac sodium, a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), fitting the description of 'Dermatological agents and local anesthet
The product is a finished aluminum shower door assembly for residential bathroom use, specifically classified under 'sanitary ware and parts thereof' per heading 7615.20.00.00.

The kit is a set of plastic articles not elsewhere specified or included, falling under the residual provision 'Other' in 3926.90.99.89, as it does not meet the specific criteria for beads (3926.90.35.00) or ornamental articles (3926.40.00).

The product is a disposable brief designed for one-time use, specifically described under 6108.22.10.00 as 'Disposable briefs and panties designed for one-time use' of man-made fibers (polypropylene).

The product is a craft kit for creating jewelry, with the primary utilitarian purpose classifying it under 3926.90.35.00 as 'Beads, bugles and spangles, not strung (except temporarily) and not set; articles thereof, not elsewhere specified or included.'
The product is a prepared meal containing shrimp and clams as the essential character, classifiable under heading 1605 per GRI 1 and Chapter 16 Note 1(b).

The vehicle is principally designed for the transport of persons, used, and has a 1.7-liter spark-ignition engine, fitting the wording of 8703.22.01.90: 'Used...Of a cylinder capacity exceeding 1,000 cc but not exceeding 1,500 cc.'

The knit bralette is classified under 6114.30.30.70 as it is a women's garment of man-made fibers, knitted, not specifically provided for elsewhere (e.g., not a blouse or shirt under 6106 or a top under 6114.30.10).

The goods are free-standing storage racks made of steel, not mountings, fittings, or fixtures for furniture or other articles, fitting the wording of HTS 7326.90.86.88 ('Other articles of iron or steel').
The GripVR is a radio remote control apparatus specifically designed for use with virtual reality headsets (video game consoles), fitting the wording of 8526.92.10.00.
The product is a gear-type rotary positive displacement pump, as described by the operational characteristics and construction, fitting the wording of 8413.60.00.30 ('Gear type').

The product consists of preserved natural flowers treated and prepared for ornamental purposes, fitting the wording of heading 0603: 'Cut flowers and flower buds... dried, dyed, bleached, impregnated or otherwise prepared.'
The product is a festive Halloween decoration classified under HTS 9505.90.60.00 as 'other' festive articles, per the heading and prior rulings (e.g., N327407, N349768).
The product is a transistor with a dissipation rate of less than 1 W (minimum 0.7 W, maximum 1.1 W), classifying it under 8541.21.00.95 as per the heading terms and chapter notes.

The kit is classifiable under 9615.11.50.00 as 'Combs, hair-slides and the like... of hard rubber or plastics... Other,' since the primary components are plastic hair clips designed for hair decoration.
The product is a tote bag with an outer surface of plastic sheeting, specifically classified under 4202.22.15.00 as 'With outer surface of sheeting of plastics' for handbags or similar containers.
The product is an upholstered seat with a wooden frame, not convertible into a bed, classifying it under 9401.61.60.31 as 'Other seats, with wooden frames, upholstered, other.'

The case is a fitted container with an outer surface of man-made textile materials, specifically designed for organizing and protecting the Neuro 20 PRO system components, fitting the description of 'similar containers' under HTS heading 4202.12.81.70.

The ABS wall mount bracket is classified under 3926.90.99.89 as 'Other articles of plastics' not specifically provided for elsewhere, as it is neither a fastener, handle, knob, nor a base metal article.
The product meets the terms of heading 1902 as 'stuffed pasta, whether or not cooked or otherwise prepared,' specifically described in subheading 1902.20.00.40 as frozen.
The product is a tote bag with an outer surface of plastic sheeting, specifically classified under HTS 4202.22.15.00 as 'Handbags... with outer surface of sheeting of plastics.'

The Pulse 2.0 Logic Board functions as a unit of an automatic data processing machine by converting and transmitting data via a TCP/IP stack, fitting the wording of heading 8471 ('Automatic data processing machines and units thereof').

The device is a digital signal processor specifically designed for audio processing in loudspeaker systems, fitting the wording of HTS 8543.70.91.00: 'Digital signal processing apparatus capable of connecting to a wired or wireless network for the mixing of sound.'

The product is a gas-fired condensing hydronic boiler designed for commercial and industrial heating applications, specifically classifiable under heading 8403 as 'Central heating boilers (other than those of heading 8402) and parts thereof.'
The product is a furnishing article of cotton, not knitted or crocheted, classifiable under HTS 6304.92.00.00 as it is primarily a textile decoration with structural wire concealed within the braid.

The product is a solid bath bar composed primarily of sodium bicarbonate, which falls under the heading for 'Carbonates; peroxocarbonates (percarbonates); commercial ammonium carbonate containing ammonium carbamate' (2836.30.00.00).
The vehicle is a used passenger sedan with a 1,994 cc spark-ignition engine, classified under 8703.22.01.90 as 'Used' motor cars with engine capacity exceeding 1,500 cc but not exceeding 3,000 cc.

The product is a steel container for liquid refrigerant (not compressed or liquefied gas) with a capacity of 50 liters or more, fitting the wording of heading 7310 and subheading 7310.10.00.90 ('Other').
The article is a threaded steel rod with an eye, fitting the description of 'screw hooks' under HTS heading 7318.
The garments are knitted, sleeveless, pullover, of man-made fibers (polyester/spandex), and fall under HTS 6110.30.30.53 for 'Other' men's or women's similar articles.

The knee protectors are classified as 'orthopedic appliances' under heading 9021, as they provide stability and impact protection for the knee during physical tasks, aligning with the wording 'Orthopedic appliances, including...appliances which are worn...to compensate for a defect or disability.'
The knee board is classified under 9506.91.00.30 as it is an article for general physical exercise or athletics, not elsewhere specified, made of polyurethane foam and designed for kneeling support.

The product consists of loose aspen wood shavings, untreated and mechanically shredded, classifiable under Chapter 44 (Wood and articles of wood), specifically 4415.20.4000 as 'Wood shavings, wood wool and wood flour,' not elsewhere specified or included.

The product is a cold-bent steel metal wire not further processed beyond shaping and welding, fitting the description of 'Wire of iron or nonalloy steel' under heading 7217, specifically 'Not plated or coated' in subheading 7217.10.90.00.
The product is a festive article for Halloween, specifically described under HTS 9505.90.60.00 as 'Other' festive decorations.
